subject: dec
title: DEC.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 87 ((AF)D-15). DEC (decentralization) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information) and POL-P (political policies). From MT-INFO: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From POL-P: INFO-COMP (information compression). From INFO-DY: EXP-F. From INFO-COMP: AS-ES. From EXP-F: PR-TR and PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From UNF-PI: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism).
